learnerSourceCheck.prompt: Use the class's genuine survey to draw a scaled bar graph with title, labels and suitable scale. Create and answer one- and two-step comparisons based on actual categories.

supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s represent our data on scaled bar graphs and answer questions about the data.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Draw a scaled bar graph to represent a data set with several categories. Solve one- and two-step “how many more” and “how many less” problems using information presented in scaled bar graphs.
teachingSteps: Collect only authentic category responses using teacher-approved methods.
Choose a title, categories, consistent scale and accurate bar lengths.
Use the graph for addition or subtraction comparisons; justify answers.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.caution: A visually plausible dataset is not evidence of authentic class responses.
